title: Cell City
description: Be the mayor of a living cell. Power it up with mitochondria, send instructions from the nucleus so ribosomes, the ER and the Golgi can build and ship proteins, recycle waste and close the membrane doors on invading viruses. Later, run a plant cell with chloroplasts and a cell wall. A pause-and-learn organelle guide explains every part.
controls: Click or tap organelles to put them to work, tap doors to open or close them, tap waste and viruses to clean them up. P pause, G guide.
